steps.title: Purify recombinant transcription factor
steps.instruction: Obtain a pure His‑MBP‑FOXP3(ΔN) protein suitable for pull‑down assays.

substeps.instruction: Thaw the cell pellet and resuspend in 40 mL protein lysis buffer; rotate at 4 °C.
Lyse cells using the Emulsiflex C3 high‑pressure homogenizer at 4 °C.
Centrifuge lysate at 10,000 × g for 30 min at 4 °C to remove debris.

Ni‑NTA affinity chromatography: load clarified supernatant onto a pre‑equilibrated Ni‑NTA column, incubate 1–2 h, wash three times with 5 column volumes of low‑imidazole wash buffer, elute the His‑tagged protein with 1 column volume of high‑imidazole elution buffer five times.

Heparin affinity chromatography: load the Ni‑NTA‑purified protein onto a HiTrap Heparin column, wash with low‑salt buffer A, elute with buffer B using a low‑to‑high salt gradient, collect the protein peak.
Concentrate the eluted protein, aliquot, flash‑freeze in liquid N₂, store at –80 °C, and verify purity and concentration by SDS‑PAGE and Bradford assay before use.

steps.title: Extract naked genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Isolate high‑quality, protein‑free genomic DNA from EL4 cells for fragmentation.

substeps.instruction: Use the Qiagen Blood & Cell Culture DNA Maxi Kit (catalog #13343) following the manufacturer’s protocol to extract DNA.
Confirm DNA integrity by agarose‑gel electrophoresis and measure A260/A280; aim for ~1.8 to ensure low protein/RNA contamination.
If the Qiagen kit is unavailable, substitute with Promega Wizard or Thermo Fisher GeneJET kits using comparable volumes and centrifugation steps.

steps.title: Assess DNA fragment size
steps.instruction: Validate the size distribution of extracted genomic DNA before pull‑down.

substeps.instruction: Run an aliquot on an Agilent Bioanalyzer High Sensitivity DNA chip (or Agilent TapeStation) and compare the profile to agarose‑gel results to confirm suitability for the assay.

steps.title: Prepare sequencing library
steps.instruction: Construct Illumina‑compatible libraries from the DNA recovered after TF pull‑down using the NEBNext Ultra II DNA Library Prep Kit (NEB #E7103S).

substeps.instruction: End preparation: Dilute recovered PD‑seq DNA to 30 ng in 50 µL using 0.1× TE (10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0, 0.1 mM EDTA) or 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0. In a sterile PCR tube on ice add 7 µL End Prep Reaction Buffer and 3 µL End Prep Enzyme Mix (total 60 µL). Mix 10×, spin, then incubate 20 °C 30 min → 65 °C 30 min → 4 °C hold.

Adaptor ligation: Dilute NEBNext Illumina adaptor 1:10 in 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 7.5‑8.0 with 10 mM NaCl. Add to the 60 µL end‑prep reaction 2.5 µL diluted adaptor, 30 µL Ultra II Ligation Master Mix, and 1 µL Ligation Enhancer (total 93.5 µL). Mix, incubate 20 °C 15 min (lid off), then add 3 µL USER Enzyme, mix, incubate 37 °C 15 min (lid ≥47 °C).

Cleanup of adaptor‑ligated DNA: Vortex NEBNext Sample Purification Beads, warm 10 min at 25 °C. Add 87 µL (0.9×) beads to the 93.5 µL ligation mix, mix, incubate 25 °C 5 min, place on magnetic stand ~5 min, discard supernatant, wash twice with 200 µL 80 % ethanol (30 s each), air‑dry ≤5 min, elute with 17 µL 10 mM Tris‑HCl or 0.1× TE, mix, incubate 25 °C 2 min, magnet 5 min, transfer 15 µL eluate. (No size selection for input ≤50 ng; follow kit instructions if >50 ng.)

PCR enrichment: In a new tube on ice combine 15 µL adaptor‑ligated DNA, 25 µL NEBNext Ultra II Q5 Master Mix, 5 µL i7 index primer, 5 µL i5 (or universal) primer (total 50 µL). Mix, spin, then run: 98 °C 30 s → (98 °C 10 s, 65 °C 75 s) ×4–5 cycles → 65 °C 5 min → hold 4 °C.
Cleanup of PCR product: Add 45 µL (0.9×) beads to the 50 µL PCR, mix, magnet, wash as above, elute in 33 µL 0.1× TE, transfer 30 µL to a new tube.

Library quality control: Quantify library concentration with Qubit, assess fragment size on an Agilent Bioanalyzer High Sensitivity chip or TapeStation. Expected size distribution 170–290 bp (≈220–230 bp average, representing 50–150 bp insert + ~120 bp adaptor). Ensure adapter‑dimer <5 % (≈120 bp peak).

steps.title: Sequence libraries on Illumina
steps.instruction: Generate paired‑end reads from the prepared libraries.

substeps.instruction: Pool libraries at equimolar concentrations based on Qubit and Bioanalyzer data.
Sequence on an Illumina platform using either a 75‑cycle kit for 2 × 38 bp reads or a 100‑cycle kit for 2 × 50 bp reads, targeting 20–50 million reads per sample.
Confirm that the chosen read length is shorter than the final library insert size to avoid sequencing through adapters.

steps.title: Analyze PD‑seq data
steps.instruction: Process raw sequencing data to identify TF binding motifs.

substeps.instruction: Quality control: Run FastQC on raw FASTQ files. If adapters or low‑quality bases are present, trim with Trimmomatic using: `trimmomatic PE sample_R1.fastq.gz sample_R2.fastq.gz sample_R1_trimmed.fastq.gz sample_R1_unpaired.fastq.gz sample_R2_trimmed.fastq.gz sample_R2_unpaired.fastq.gz ILLUMINACLIP:adapters.fa:2:30:10 LEADING:3 TRAILING:3 SLIDINGWINDOW:4:15 MINLEN:36`. Re‑run FastQC to verify ≥Q30 for >90 % bases.

Read mapping: Align trimmed reads to the appropriate reference genome (e.g., mm10) with Bowtie2: `bowtie2 -x mm10_index -1 sample_R1_trimmed.fastq.gz -2 sample_R2_trimmed.fastq.gz --very-sensitive -p 8 2> sample_align.log | samtools view -bS - > sample.bam`. Sort and index with SAMtools: `samtools sort sample.bam -o sample_sorted.bam` and `samtools index sample_sorted.bam`. Generate alignment stats with `samtools flagstat sample_sorted.bam`.

Cross‑correlation QC: Compute strand cross‑correlation using phantompeakqualtools: `Rscript run_spp.R -c=sample_sorted.bam -savp-out=sample.cc.qc.txt`. Record NSC and RSC; accept NSC > 1.05 (good > 1.10) and RSC > 0.8 (good > 1.0).

Peak calling: Run MACS2 with TF and control BAMs: `macs2 callpeak -t FoxP3_sorted.bam -c Input_sorted.bam MBP_sorted.bam -f BAMPE -g mm -n FoxP3_PDseq --outdir macs2_output/ -q 0.05`. Visualize peaks in IGV to confirm enrichment.

FRiP calculation: Extract peak regions (`cut -f1-3 FoxP3_PDseq_peaks.narrowPeak > FoxP3_peaks.bed`). Count reads in peaks: `samtools view -b -L FoxP3_peaks.bed FoxP3_sorted.bam > peaks_reads.bam`. Obtain total mapped reads (`samtools flagstat FoxP3_sorted.bam`) and reads in peaks (`samtools flagstat peaks_reads.bam`). Compute FRiP = reads in peaks / total reads; values ≥0.20 indicate strong enrichment.

Motif discovery: Create 200 bp windows centered on peak summits (`bedtools slop -i FoxP3_PDseq_summits.bed -g mm10.chrom.sizes -b 100 > summits_200bp.bed`) and extract sequences (`bedtools getfasta -fi mm10.fa -bed summits_200bp.bed -fo FoxP3_peaks.fa`). Perform de novo motif analysis with either HOMER (`findMotifsGenome.pl FoxP3_PDseq_peaks.narrowPeak mm10 FoxP3_motifs/ -size 200 -len 8,10,12,15,20`) or MEME‑CHIP (`meme-chip -oc meme_output/ -meme-mod anr -meme-minw 6 -meme-maxw 30 -dreme-e 0.05 -centrimo-maxreg 200 FoxP3_peaks.fa`). Compare motif enrichment against Input and MBP controls to confirm specificity.
